name: LX International Corp.
summary: LX International Corp. engages in the trading business in Korea and internationally. It is also involved in business development and investment, financing, raw material supply, and logistics activities. In addition, the company supplies crude palm oil; develops nickel and lithium; owns palm oil plantations; trades in nickel, coal, and palm oil; generates renewable power; and manufactures flat glass. The company was formerly known as LG International Corp. and changed its name to LX International Corp. in July 2021. LX International Corp. was founded in 1953 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
